selection_rule: Research value first; confidence separates observed mechanisms from untested causal benefits.

studies.minimum_live: Paired fixed-parent 2x2: existing evidence vs two additional complete preservation anchors; target-only vs team-vote risk feedback. Preserve existing full evidence and outer gates. Preregister expanded evidence accounting and fresh identities.
studies.minimum_offline: Use the fixed 31 Full candidates as a retrospective panel assay; select panels from parent-only risk features, compare uniform and risk-stratified coverage, group by opportunity/parent for evaluation. This is a selected catalog diagnostic, not optimizer efficacy.
studies.name: Team-vote and preservation evidence
studies.token_cost: Offline zero API. Two extra questions on 50 roots and 76 evaluated edits would add 252 logical Solver evaluations, roughly 0.25M tokens using observed physical-call mean; added optimizer input, recovery and new baseline costs are separate. Illustrative rather than a ceiling.

studies.minimum_live: Two fixed parent states x two target members x two delivery policies = eight opportunities, with equal role evidence and generation budgets. If needed use a separate ranking-by-capacity factorial. Compare delivered records, recurring critical losses and Full Vote per token.
studies.minimum_offline: Replay retrieval only and assert a relevant Full record survives serialization with explicit scopes; preserve all mathematical evidence. Separate ranking and capacity effects.
studies.name: Actual delivery and reuse of Full Memory
studies.token_cost: Offline zero API. Eight opportunities around 3.2M tokens at this run mean, excluding bootstrap; additional Memory input and role latency must be measured, not assumed.

studies.minimum_live: Four frozen parent-child pairs x twenty preregistered Optimize questions x two prompts x three independent provider realizations = 480 logical evaluations. Include repairs, pivotal preservation, sole coverage and unaffected controls. Two manually written conditional repair prompts add 120 evaluations. Never treat cached same-identity predictions as independent draws.
studies.name: Solver stability and additive-repair positive control
studies.token_cost: Roughly 0.47M plus 0.12M tokens at observed physical Solver-call mean, before recovery and bootstrap. This is a mechanism study with fresh authorization, not a formal-run rerun or generalization claim.

studies.minimum_live: One hundred frozen wrong-example/prompt pairs x two instruction variants, each retaining full evidence, with at most three draws. Blindly score mathematical diagnosis and implementability as well as format success.
studies.minimum_offline: Byte-preservation and strict schema tests for mathematical symbols, escapes and unintended decoded controls; no parser loosening or fabricated response repair.
studies.name: Gradient serialization and bounded semantic quality
studies.token_cost: At observed 1.5 draws per example, about 300 Gradient calls or 1.4M tokens; maximum 600 draws requires its own frozen token ceiling. Successful but impoverished diagnoses do not count as improvement.

studies.minimum_live: Within one newly authorized attempt compare fresh extraction with accepted-only reuse; never reuse rejected outputs to replace recovery, and invalidate on any required-context change. Measure useful candidate production and Full Vote per token.
studies.minimum_offline: Classify exact complete-context identities and accepted-diagnosis novelty, with parent prompt, ordinary response, reference, lane, policy and provenance all included. Do not drop information to increase hits.
studies.name: Context-complete accepted diagnosis reuse and stable mechanism identities
studies.token_cost: Observed repeated new physical Gradient requests cost 6,228,336 tokens; this is a gross exposure, not a guaranteed saving. Live A/B cost needs scope-specific freeze.

studies.minimum_live: One common frozen parent, one equal-budget opportunity for each of five target members; optionally replicate at a second parent. Compare stage-specific failures, useful Full proposals and cost with the member selected by current WHO. Do not make updating all five members a success condition.
studies.name: Stage-aware opportunity allocation
studies.token_cost: Five opportunities about 2M tokens; ten about 4M, excluding common bootstrap. Small diagnostic only; insufficient by itself to establish an optimal scheduler.

studies.minimum_live: Fixed-parent append vs conditional rewrite with equal cap and information; a separate intervention passes diagnosis detail and worked references. A closed NO_SAFE reason field is observational self-report and changes the generation contract, so preregister it separately.
studies.minimum_offline: Compute the exact remaining rendered-prompt budget; review which detailed Gradient diagnosis is lost before Reflection. Test preservation of complete readable evidence.
studies.name: Conditional prompt rewrite and diagnosis-to-edit observability
studies.token_cost: Offline zero API first. Live paired opportunities incur ordinary optimizer/Solver costs; rewrite must not remove useful rules merely to fit a cap.
